subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this PR keep any generic Tooling-section sub-agent rubric, or should all remaining wording be folded into the existing config-gated delegation and tool-description surfaces?
rationale: The PR is prompt-policy work on a maintainer-labeled branch, and current main already has multiple overlapping delegation surfaces; the permanent prompt owner should choose the single source of truth.

options.title: Consolidate Into Existing Surfaces
options.body: Rebase and move any useful wording into `buildSubagentDelegationPreferenceSection` or `describeSessionsSpawnTool()` so prompt policy stays config-aware.

options.title: Keep A Separate Tooling Rubric
options.body: Accept the extra generic section and own the risk that it diverges from config-specific delegation guidance.

options.title: Close As Superseded Manually
options.body: A maintainer may decide the merged prompt/tool-description work already covers the useful part and close the branch after noting the newer PRs.

recommendation.title: Consolidate Into Existing Surfaces
recommendation.body: Rebase and move any useful wording into `buildSubagentDelegationPreferenceSection` or `describeSessionsSpawnTool()` so prompt policy stays config-aware.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the merged current-main orchestration prompt and active-child guidance that this PR now overlaps.
